description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Products are sorted when a sort option is applied
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed and contains <several products with differing values for the attribute being sorted>. <a sort option available in the product list> is known to the tester.
steps: Note the order of the products shown before sorting.
Apply <a sort option available in the product list>.
cases.expected: The product list is re-ordered according to the applied sort option; the products appear in the correct order for that option. The exact sort options and their ordering rules are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Switching from one sort option to another re-sorts the list
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed and contains <several products with differing values for the attributes being sorted>. At least two sort options are available.
steps: Apply <a first sort option available in the product list> and note the resulting order.
Apply <a second, different sort option available in the product list>.
cases.expected: The list is re-sorted according to the second sort option, replacing the order produced by the first option. The exact sort options and their ordering rules are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting a list that contains no products
cases.preconditions: A product list view that currently shows no products (for example <a category or search result with zero products>).
steps: Open the product list so that no products are shown.
Apply <a sort option available in the product list>.
cases.expected: No error occurs and the empty list is still displayed. The exact behaviour and any message for an empty list are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting a list that contains a single product
cases.preconditions: A product list view that currently shows exactly one product (for example <a category or search result with exactly one product>).
steps: Open the product list so that one product is shown.
Apply <a sort option available in the product list>.
cases.expected: No error occurs and the single product remains displayed. The exact behaviour for a single-item list is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting products that have equal values for the sorted attribute
cases.preconditions: The product list is displayed and contains <at least two products with identical values for the attribute being sorted>.
steps: Apply <the sort option matching the attribute where the products have identical values>.
cases.expected: The list is sorted without error and the products with identical values appear together in the sorted order. The tie-breaking rule is not specified in the story.
